name: Foundation of Rio de Janeiro
description: The city of Rio de Janeiro is founded by the Portuguese on March 1, 1565.

name: Invasion of French Privateers
description: In September 1710, Rio de Janeiro is invaded and occupied by French privateers under the command of René Duguay-Trouin.

name: Transfer of Portuguese Royal Court
description: In November 1807, the Portuguese royal court, led by Dom João VI, arrives in Rio de Janeiro due to the French invasion of Portugal.

name: Brazilian Independence
description: On September 7, 1822, Brazil declares its independence from Portugal, marking a significant event in the history of Rio de Janeiro.

name: Construction of Christ the Redeemer
description: The construction of the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado Mountain begins in 1922 and is completed in 1931.

name: Olympic Games in Rio de Janeiro
description: Rio de Janeiro hosts the Summer Olympic Games from August 5 to August 21, 2016, showcasing the city on a global stage.

name: Carnival in Rio de Janeiro
description: The world-famous Carnival of Rio de Janeiro takes place annually, featuring vibrant parades, music, and dance.

name: Foundation of the National Museum
description: The National Museum of Brazil is founded in Rio de Janeiro on June 6, 1818, showcasing a vast collection of natural history and cultural artifacts.

name: Opening of Rio-Niteroi Bridge
description: The Rio-Niteroi Bridge, a landmark in Rio de Janeiro, is inaugurated on March 4, 1974, connecting the cities of Rio de Janeiro and Niteroi.

name: Maracanã Stadium Inauguration
description: On June 16, 1950, Maracanã Stadium in Rio de Janeiro is inaugurated as the largest stadium in the world at the time, hosting the FIFA World Cup final.
